groups.title: Boundaries
groups.purpose: The state and district outlines every layer is clipped to.

sources.license: Free for academic/non-commercial use; attribution required
sources.notes: State + district polygons for Arunachal Pradesh. Defines the AOI clip.

groups.title: Terrain
groups.purpose: Elevation, and everything derived from its shape — slope, curvature, wetness.

sources.license: Free, worldwide, non-exclusive (ESA/Copernicus). Attribution required.
sources.notes: 28 one-degree COG tiles covering the AOI. 30 m posting, EGM2008 vertical datum.

groups.title: Soil & geology
groups.purpose: What the slope is made of: soil texture and depth, rock type, fault lines.

sources.license: CC-BY 4.0
sources.notes: 250 m soil properties, mean prediction, depths 0-5cm, 15-30cm, 60-100cm. Values are scaled integers — see ISRIC conversion factors (clay/sand/silt g/kg ÷10 = %, bdod cg/cm3 ÷100, soc dg/kg ÷10).

sources.license: NASA open data
sources.notes: 3 granules sampled via CMR. Global HDF5 at 9 km. Coarse for mountain slopes — the Appendix flags this as the weakest free substitute for pore pressure, and that stands.

sources.source: APSSDI / Arunachal Pradesh Space Application Centre (APSAC)
sources.license: UNSTATED — portal publishes no licence. Confirm with APSAC before redistribution. Attribute coding suggests NRSC/Bhuvan lineage.
sources.notes: Open WFS, no auth required. Statewide, ~1:50,000. Replaces the 3-class free geology that DATA_VERIFICATION.md marked unusable.

groups.title: Land cover
groups.purpose: What is growing on it, or built on it.

sources.license: CC-BY 4.0
sources.notes: 10 m global land cover, 11 classes. Class codes: 10 tree, 20 shrub, 30 grass, 40 crop, 50 built, 60 bare, 70 snow/ice, 80 water, 90 herbaceous wetland, 95 mangrove, 100 moss/lichen.

groups.title: Hydrology
groups.purpose: Rivers, catchments and river discharge — the flood module's foundation.

sources.license: Free for non-commercial and commercial use with attribution (WWF)
sources.notes: 15 arc-second base. Rivers carry UPLAND_SKM (upstream drainage area) — the field that determines which streams a large-river forecast can reach. Basin levels 8 and 12 clipped for catchment-scale work.

sources.license: Copernicus / CEMS-FLOODS licence
sources.notes: 0.05 deg (~5.5 km) river discharge. Forecast = operational control run out to 30 days; historical = consolidated reanalysis for calibration. Independent of Google Flood Hub.

sources.source: APSSDI / Arunachal Pradesh Space Application Centre (APSAC)
sources.license: UNSTATED — portal publishes no licence. Confirm with APSAC before redistribution. Attribute coding suggests NRSC/Bhuvan lineage.
sources.notes: Open WFS, no auth required. Statewide, ~1:50,000. Replaces the 3-class free geology that DATA_VERIFICATION.md marked unusable.

groups.title: Weather
groups.purpose: Daily rainfall, the input that makes a forecast a forecast rather than a map.

sources.license: Public domain (US Government)
sources.notes: GFS subset server-side to the AOI. Lead times 6h, 24h, 72h, 120h, 168h. GRIB2 files are overwritten each run — this is a live feed, not an archive; historical GFS needs a separate archive source.

sources.source: GPM IMERG Late Daily V07B (GES DISC)
sources.license: NASA open data
sources.notes: 132 daily files, OPeNDAP-subset to the AOI (~11 km, 0.1 deg). Season 2024-06-01..2024-09-30 plus recent days for latency. Units mm/day. Late run has ~1 day latency; Final run (3IMERGDF) is research-grade with ~3 month lag.

sources.license: Licence to use Copernicus Products
sources.notes: 3-hourly, ~9 km, 2024-06..09. Carries soil water at depth and snowmelt — variables IMERG and SMAP cannot provide. Precipitation is in metres per hour, not mm.

sources.license: NASA open data
sources.notes: Daily IMERG late run, 2001-01-01..2001-12-31, subset to Arunachal bbox server-side. 495 files on disk.

groups.title: Seismic
groups.purpose: Earthquake shaking, a second trigger for slope failure.

sources.source: USGS FDSN event + IRIS FDSN station
sources.license: Public domain (USGS); open (IRIS/EarthScope)
sources.notes: Real-time capable APIs, no key. Regional catalogue buffered 2.0 deg because triggering shaking often originates outside the AOI.

groups.title: Evidence
groups.purpose: Mapped landslides and observed flooding — the record every model is fitted and judged on.

sources.source: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (unofficial ArcGIS re-host)
sources.license: NASA data is public domain; re-host terms unverified
sources.notes: 99 events intersecting the AOI. PROVISIONAL — official NASA endpoints unreachable at fetch time. Location accuracy is coarse (km-level), so these support validation far better than training.

sources.source: GSI National Landslide Forecasting Centre — national landslide inventory
sources.license: RESTRICTED — GSI asserts 'not to be published in part or full without prior permission of the Director General, GSI'. Confirm before shipping.
sources.notes: 1322 landslides in AOI (31,551 nationally). Full attribute schema: district, material, movement type, trigger, runout, casualties. Only 0 carry a date — spatial inventory, not an event catalogue. Retrieved via the portal's own proxy.ashx; undocumented, availability unguaranteed.

sources.source: GSI National Landslide Forecasting Centre — mapped landslide polygons
sources.license: RESTRICTED — GSI asserts 'not to be published in part or full without prior permission of the Director General, GSI'. Confirm before shipping.
sources.notes: 26459 mapped landslide extents in AOI, DATA_TYPE='Mapped as polygon'. Attributes: material, movement class, LULC, geomorphology, district, toposheet. True failure geometry — supersedes point centroids for training. No dates.

sources.source: NRSC Bhuvan landslide inventory (ISRO/NRSC), Arunachal Pradesh
sources.license: UNSTATED — Bhuvan terms apply. NRSC/ISRO product; confirm redistribution rights before use in a commercial deliverable.
sources.notes: 11329 landslide polygons across 2014/2017/2023 seasons. Harvested via WMS GetFeatureInfo because WFS is disabled server-side. Polygons carry length/width/height, area, activity state, lithology, LULC and trigger. Coverage is per-season and NOT statewide — check district coverage before assuming a given area is represented.

sources.license: UNSTATED — Bhuvan terms apply. Confirm before redistribution.
sources.notes: Binary observed-flood mask derived from a rendered tile service; no per-year or depth information is available through this endpoint.

sources.license: WorldPop CC-BY 4.0; OSM ODbL; WDPA non-commercial terms
sources.notes: OSM counts are a coverage test as much as a data pull — thin mapping in Arunachal directly limits any impact/exposure product.

groups.title: River gauges
groups.purpose: Measured river levels and flows — what a river forecast is trained on and graded against.

sources.license: open, no login (ffs.india-water.gov.in)
other-open (NWDP: hydrological analysis, flood forecasting, water resource management)
sources.notes: Two resources of the dataset river-discharge-telemetry-hourly-central-water-commission-cwc: 9c755c40 (2023 to Sept 2025) and 9a7feb81 (Jan 2026 on). 14 Arunachal stations. scripts/fetch/fetch_24_nwdp_discharge.py. Record written after the fact on 2026-10-07: fetch date is the newest file's modification time; checksums taken then.

groups.title: Satellite
groups.purpose: Radar scenes from flood dates, read by the water test that verifies the flood record.

sources.source: Sentinel-1 GRD radar scenes (Copernicus Data Space)
sources.license: Copernicus Sentinel data — free, full and open access
sources.notes: IW GRDH scenes on and around flood dates, read by the radar water test behind the verified flood record. scripts/fetch/fetch_14_sentinel.py, fetch_22 to 27. Record written after the fact on 2026-10-07: fetch date is the newest file's modification time; checksums taken then.

groups.title: Flood records
groups.purpose: A global archive of dated large floods — candidates to verify, not labels.

sources.license: CC0
sources.notes: 5,503 dated large flood events worldwide. Downloaded by hand from Zenodo (the Dartmouth Flood Observatory's own archive returns HTTP 410). Record written after the fact on 2026-10-07: fetch date is the newest file's modification time; checksums taken then.
